head: FormWright 3D: modeling, sculpting and animation on iPad and iPhone
dek: FormWright 3D brings 3D modeling, sculpting, painting and animation together on iPad and iPhone in one local project. It was #23 among paid Graphics & Design apps on the US App Store on 6 November.
details: It costs $19.99 with in-app purchases, by Don Stevenson.
means: If you make 3D characters or props, you can do it all on an iPad.
todo: Find FormWright 3D in the App Store.
